gate_results.rationale: The document makes many load-bearing factual and quantitative claims (e.g., 'Set theory pays nine axioms', 'Gravity is 10^36 weaker than electromagnetism', 'Strong nuclear force is 137 times stronger than electromagnetism', 'The cosmological constant is tuned to 1 part in 10^120', 'The Hubble Tension is a 5-sigma discrepancy', 'The Hessian matrix ... scored this variable as the most connected node in the entire system') without any traceable citations, derivations, or data. The source itself acknowledges the mappings are not yet adversarially tested (S402), but the body text presents them as established. No evidence items can be cited for these claims beyond the assertions themselves.

Several tensions are present but mostly acknowledged and bounded rather than load-bearing and unresolved. The document explicitly states the argument could be wrong (S225), that the match could be coincidence (S226), and that a skeptic could write the opposite essay (S227). However, the claim that the axiom 'cannot be proven' is simultaneously a 'signature' of a genuine Layer 0 (S040-S045) and that 'Godel guarantees it' (S048, S311) is a strong, unproven assertion that functions as a load-bearing claim while being presented as settled. The contradiction between 'physics is not allowed to smuggle in theology' (S282) and the extensive theological reading of physical forces (S139, S149, S235-S245) is acknowledged as a 'bridge' (S401) but the bridge validity is not established. These are local and acknowledged, not fully resolved.
gate_results.resolution: The document acknowledges the limits of its claims in S225-S230 and S401-S402, but the Godel claim remains an unresolved load-bearing assertion.

It acknowledges that physics 'does not say why the world has those features' (S400) and that the bridge is 'declared' not proven (S401). However, the conclusion that the ten laws 'describe a Person' (S259) and that 'only one Person in history matches it' (S130) exceeds what the evidence and method can support. gate_results.rationale: The document explicitly names kill conditions: 'a force with no matching structure' (S410) and states that the argument could be wrong (S225). It says it 'names its own kill conditions in advance, out loud, so anyone can check' (S230). This is a genuine attempt at falsifiability, though the kill conditions are broad and the document does not specify what evidence would count against the Godel claim or the necessary ground argument.

The document makes extensive cross-domain claims mapping physical laws to spiritual concepts (S235-S245) and divine attributes (S299-S306). The bridge is asserted rather than validated.

The document has a metadata block with a source SHA256 and an original file path (front matter), and it cites biblical passages (e.g., S078, S141, S155, S162, S174, S207, S216). However, the quantitative claims (S132, S143, S151, S360, S365) lack citations to specific papers, datasets, or derivations. The Hessian matrix claim (S151) is particularly opaque. The provenance of the core argument is traceable to the author's framework but not to external evidence.

atoms.title: GOD AS ROOT - Long Edition
atoms.summary: Long-form source edition arguing the Trinitarian God is the single unprovable Layer-0 axiom paying four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation); physics is the created medium/grammar for love, choice, and grace; ten physical laws compose a portrait matching Christ with agency as the repeated structural gap; the framework inverts 'God of the gaps' by reading God in the completions, names kill conditions in advance, and lays out the Cross-Resolution method, the 24-step Descent, progressive revelation, and the canon reading order.

atoms.name: The Trinity Is the Single Ground Axiom
atoms.statementTechnical: The Trinitarian God (aseity, perichoresis, love) is the one Layer-0 axiom from which existence, distinction, relation, and orientation derive; it is unprovable by design (DG1).
atoms.statementPlain: God is the floor beneath everything; you can't prove Him because a provable axiom would rest on something deeper.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Demonstrate a deeper ground from which the Trinity derives, or show the four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) are derivable without it.
atoms.notes: Four debts: existence, distinction, relation, orientation.

atoms.name: Physics Is the Created Medium, Not God
atoms.statementTechnical: Physics is the ordered created medium enabling relation, consequence, choice, time, repair, embodiment, and love to be publicly meaningful; it is not grace and not the Creator.
atoms.statementPlain: Physics is the grammar God speaks so creatures can exist, choose, and be redeemed — not God, not grace.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show a world where love, choice, consequence, and repair are real without any lawful physical medium, or show physics is identical to grace/God.

atoms.name: Ten Laws Compose a Portrait of Christ
atoms.statementTechnical: Measured properties of ten physical structures (gravity, strong force, EM, mass-energy, thermodynamics, information, relativity, QM, weak force, coherence) read together compose a specific personal portrait; agency is the identical missing variable in all ten.
atoms.statementPlain: Read the ten laws together and they describe one Person; the same gap — agency — appears ten times.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Produce a force whose measured properties have no matching spiritual structure, or show the ten mappings are arbitrary/coincidental under adversarial test.

atoms.name: God in the Completions, Not the Gaps
atoms.statementTechnical: The framework reads ten fully explained laws, not unexplained gaps; the more science explains, the clearer the portrait, so it does not bet on science failing.
atoms.statementPlain: God isn't hiding in what we don't know; He's written into what we do know.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show that the portrait depends on scientific ignorance, i.e., that fuller explanation dissolves the structural match.

atoms.name: The Necessary Ground Argument
atoms.statementTechnical: If closed systems decay and the universe persists, an external source must be necessary, self-grounding, origin of coherence, active, and personal; these map to aseity, self-sufficiency, eternality, omnipresence, Logos, providence, personhood.
atoms.statementPlain: The universe needs a source outside itself that is necessary, self-grounding, active, and personal — the God theologians already described.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the universe is a closed system that sustains itself, or that the five required properties are jointly incoherent or unnecessary.

atoms.statementTechnical: A 24-step causal chain from God's creation through distinction, information, relation, value, moral valence, agency, decay, adversarial refusal, debt, justice, mercy, and grace converges at Christ.
atoms.statementPlain: Follow being all the way down and you arrive at the Cross.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Identify a step that does not follow, or show the chain can terminate elsewhere without smuggling premises.

atoms.name: Progressive Revelation as Reference-Frame Building
atoms.statementTechnical: God reveals incrementally (slavery, wilderness, Law, prophets, exile) because receivers lack the reference frame to parse the full signal at once.
atoms.statementPlain: God teaches like a teacher: you don't teach calculus to a child who can't count.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show revelation is not progressive or that the reference-frame account adds nothing over arbitrary historical contingency.

atoms.name: The Cross-Resolution Method
atoms.statementTechnical: Every major claim must be read in its proper register (theology, physics, mathematics, lived reality, bridge); no register may smuggle in another, and bridges must be marked with strength and limits.
atoms.statementPlain: Test each claim where it belongs; mark the bridges honestly; no hidden upgrades.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the method permits smuggling (e.g., theology rescuing weak physics) or that it cannot be applied consistently.

atoms.name: The Empty Tomb as Physics Claim
atoms.statementTechnical: Resurrection entails two physics claims: information survives destruction of its container, and entropy is locally reversed by coupling to an external source.
atoms.statementPlain: The empty tomb says the pattern outlives the substrate and decay gets reversed from outside.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show information cannot survive substrate destruction in principle, or that no external coupling can locally reverse entropy.

atoms.name: Pre-Human Math
atoms.statementTechnical: E=mc^2 operated for 4.6 billion years before Einstein formulated it.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the equation is observer-dependent or did not hold pre-formulation.

atoms.name: Fine-Tuning of the Cosmological Constant
atoms.statementTechnical: Cosmological constant tuned to 1 part in 10^120.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the tuning is necessary or the figure is wrong.

atoms.name: Hubble Tension
atoms.statementTechnical: Universe expands at two rates depending on measurement; 5-sigma discrepancy.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the discrepancy resolves within standard models without new framework.

atoms.name: Honest Limit / Kill Conditions
atoms.statementTechnical: The match could be coincidence; a skeptic could write the opposite essay; the framework needs science to keep succeeding and the pattern to keep holding.
atoms.falsificationCondition: A force with no matching structure, or collapse of the ten-law pattern under adversarial testing.

atoms.name: Why Does the World Need Physics?
atoms.statementTechnical: If God is sovereign, why gravity, entropy, quantum uncertainty, a running-down universe?
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show physics is unnecessary for creaturely love, choice, and repair.

atoms.name: Why a Tree?
atoms.statementTechnical: The tree is free will made visible; freedom without a real choice is a word.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show a genuine choice is possible without any real alternative.

atoms.name: Why Not Make God Impossible to Miss?
atoms.statementTechnical: The adversary saw God directly and rebelled; proximity never guaranteed loyalty; faith is the proof of love proximity cannot fake.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show that direct sight guarantees loyalty.

atoms.name: What About the Cross?
atoms.statementTechnical: The uncorrupted pattern voluntarily enters the broken system; 'It is finished' is successful deployment; the veil tears top-down.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the cross is defeat rather than the mechanism that ends the adversary.

source_selection.exact_source_expression: The universe needs a source outside itself that is necessary, self-grounding, active, and personal — the God theologians already described. [P82-S290..P84-S297; P86-S299..S306]
source_selection.reason: This is the paper's most explicitly mathematical claim: five required properties of a sustaining source, presented as following from premises about closed systems, coherence, and moral realism. It is the only claim in the paper that the paper itself flags as 'partially formalized' with 'five proofs' (S402). It can be given a precise Lean statement as a conditional theorem over an abstract ontology, with the theological identification kept as a separate, non-formal bridge.

formal_object.exact_proposed_statement: In any ontology O equipped with a sustainment relation and a coherence predicate, if (i) every closed subsystem of O strictly degrades its coherence under its own dynamics, (ii) the whole of O does not degrade, and (iii) coherence is universal and measurable, then there exists a distinguished entity g in O such that g is necessary (exists in every model of O), self-grounding (no sustainment chain from g to a distinct entity), the origin of coherence (every coherent entity's coherence is sustained through g), active (g's sustainment is not a fixed point of the degradation dynamics), and personal (g grounds the moral-value predicate).

symbol_table.formal_definition: structure Ontology where Carrier : Type; Sustains : Carrier → Carrier → Prop; Coherent : Carrier → Prop; Degrades : Carrier → Carrier → Prop; MoralValue : Carrier → Prop
symbol_table.reader_meaning: An abstract universe with a sustainment relation, a coherence predicate, a degradation dynamics, and a moral-value predicate.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def ClosedSubsystem (O : Ontology) (S : Set O.Carrier) : Prop := ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y, O.Sustains x y → y ∈ S
symbol_table.reader_meaning: A part of the universe that receives nothing from outside itself.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def Necessary (O : Ontology) (g : O.Carrier) : Prop := ∀ (M : Model O), M.interprets g
symbol_table.reader_meaning: Cannot fail to exist; present in every admissible model.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def SelfGrounding (O : Ontology) (g : O.Carrier) : Prop := ¬ ∃ h, h ≠ g ∧ O.Sustains g h
symbol_table.reader_meaning: Does not depend on anything else; no infinite regress.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def OriginOfCoherence (O : Ontology) (g : O.Carrier) : Prop := ∀ x, O.Coherent x → O.Sustains x g
symbol_table.reader_meaning: The source of truth, order, beauty, goodness, life.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def Active (O : Ontology) (g : O.Carrier) : Prop := ¬ (∀ x, O.Sustains x g → O.Sustains g x)
symbol_table.reader_meaning: Not a passive fixed point; sustains by ongoing action.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def Personal (O : Ontology) (g : O.Carrier) : Prop := ∀ x, O.MoralValue x → O.Sustains x g
symbol_table.reader_meaning: Only persons can ground moral facts.

explicit_premises: P1 (ClosedDecay): ∀ S, ClosedSubsystem O S → ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ y, O.Degrades x y ∧ ¬ O.Coherent y
P3 (CoherenceUniversal): ∀ x, O.Coherent x → ∃ y, O.Sustains x y
P5 (NoInfiniteRegress): every sustainment chain in O is well-founded
custom_axioms: P1 is the formal reading of the Second Law applied to closed subsystems (S164–S169).
P4 is the moral-realism premise the paper states explicitly (S297).
assumptions_and_dependencies.theological_starting_premises: None inside the Lean statement. The identification of the entity g with the Trinitarian God of Christian theology is a bridge claim, not a premise of the theorem. The theorem establishes only that some entity with the five properties exists under P1–P5.
assumptions_and_dependencies.non_vacuity_requirement: The theorem is non-vacuous only if there exists at least one Ontology satisfying P1–P5. A witness model must be supplied (e.g., a finite carrier with a designated g and a sustainment relation satisfying the premises) to demonstrate the hypotheses are jointly satisfiable.

verification_controls.interpretation: Lean corpus not searched in this run; no build attempted.
Declaration is proposed, not yet written.
Must confirm no unintended axioms beyond P1–P5.

verification_controls.command_or_evidence: Provide a concrete Ontology instance satisfying P1–P5 and instantiate the theorem.
verification_controls.interpretation: Without a witness, the theorem may be vacuously true.

verification_controls.command_or_evidence: Construct an Ontology satisfying P1–P3 but not P4 and show the conclusion fails.

result_and_boundary.what_is_established: If formalized and proved, the theorem would establish that under the five stated premises, an entity with the five required properties exists in any ontology satisfying them. This is a conditional existence result.
result_and_boundary.what_remains_open: Whether the premises P1–P5 hold of the actual physical universe; whether the entity so obtained is unique; whether the identification with the Trinitarian God is warranted; whether the moral-realism premise P4 is defensible.
result_and_boundary.encoding_fidelity_review: The formalization abstracts away from the paper's specific physics (Second Law, decoherence) into a general degradation dynamics. This is faithful to the paper's own framing (S290–S291) but loses the empirical content. The 'personal' predicate is formalized as grounding moral value, matching S297 but not the paper's fuller Trinitarian description (S019–S022).
result_and_boundary.interpretive_connections: Connects to the paper's claim that 'the math gave us all the tools to find Him — except the ability to prove Him without Him' (S412). The theorem is a conditional existence result, not an unconditional proof of God, which is consistent with the paper's own Layer-0 claim (S040–S045).

source_selection.exact_source_expression: God is the floor beneath everything; you can't prove Him because a provable axiom would rest on something deeper. [P07-S010..S014; P15-S040..S045]
source_selection.reason: The paper makes a precise structural claim: that the ground axiom of a formal system cannot be proved within that system, and that this is a signature of a genuine Layer 0. This is a meta-mathematical claim that can be stated in Lean as a theorem about formal systems and their axiom sets, closely related to Gödel's incompleteness theorems.

formal_object.exact_proposed_statement: For any formal system F with a distinguished ground axiom g, if g is the unique axiom of F and F is consistent, then there is no derivation in F of g from the empty set of premises. More generally, if g is an axiom of F, then g is not derivable in F from F's other axioms alone unless F is inconsistent.

symbol_table.formal_definition: structure FormalSystem where Formula : Type; Axiom : Set Formula; Derives : Set Formula → Formula → Prop; sound : ∀ {Γ φ}, Derives Γ φ → (∀ ψ ∈ Γ, True) → True
symbol_table.reader_meaning: An abstract formal system with formulas, axioms, and a derivability relation.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def GroundAxiom (F : FormalSystem) (g : F.Formula) : Prop := g ∈ F.Axiom ∧ ∀ h ∈ F.Axiom, h = g
symbol_table.reader_meaning: The single axiom at the floor of the system.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def DerivableFromEmpty (F : FormalSystem) (φ : F.Formula) : Prop := F.Derives ∅ φ
symbol_table.reader_meaning: Provable without any premises.

explicit_premises: F is a formal system with a derivability relation.
g is the unique axiom of F.
F is consistent (no formula and its negation are both derivable from ∅).
assumptions_and_dependencies.theological_starting_premises: None. The theorem is purely meta-mathematical. The identification of g with God is a bridge claim outside the theorem.
assumptions_and_dependencies.non_vacuity_requirement: There must exist at least one formal system with a unique axiom; e.g., a trivial system with one axiom and no rules.

verification_controls.command_or_evidence: Construct a system where g is derivable from other axioms and show the theorem's hypothesis fails.
verification_controls.interpretation: Confirms the uniqueness hypothesis is needed.

result_and_boundary.what_is_established: If formalized, the theorem would establish a structural fact about formal systems: a unique ground axiom is not derivable from the empty premise set in a consistent system. This is a trivial consequence of consistency and does not require Gödel's theorems.
result_and_boundary.what_remains_open: The paper's stronger claim that 'if God COULD be proven, God would not be the ground' (S045) requires an additional bridge premise identifying the formal ground axiom with God. That bridge is not formalized here.
result_and_boundary.encoding_fidelity_review: The formalization captures the structural claim but not the theological identification. The paper's appeal to Gödel (S048, S311) is stronger than what this theorem needs; the theorem is closer to a definitional observation about axiom systems.
result_and_boundary.interpretive_connections: Connects to A05 (necessary ground) and to the paper's Layer-0 / DG1 terminology (S044).

source_selection.exact_source_expression: Read the ten laws together and they describe one Person; the same gap — agency — appears ten times. [P67-S235..S245; P68-S246..S250]
source_selection.reason: The paper makes a structural claim: that each of ten physical-law/spiritual-reading pairs has the same missing variable (agency) in the same structural position. This can be formalized as a claim about a family of partial mappings, each with a distinguished hole, and the claim that the holes are all of the same type. The formalization is modest but precise.

formal_object.exact_proposed_statement: Define a LawPair as a structure with a physical component, a spiritual component, and a distinguished missing variable. Define the ten law pairs of the paper. Define the predicate SameGapType which holds of a family of LawPairs when all their missing variables are of the same type (Agency). State the claim that the ten law pairs of the paper satisfy SameGapType.

symbol_table.formal_definition: structure LawPair where physical : String; spiritual : String; missing : Type
symbol_table.reader_meaning: A pairing of a physical law with a spiritual reading, together with the type of the missing variable.

symbol_table.formal_definition: inductive Agency : Type | mk : Agency
symbol_table.reader_meaning: The capacity for free choice, the repeated missing piece.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def SameGapType (ps : List LawPair) : Prop := ∀ p ∈ ps, p.missing = Agency
symbol_table.reader_meaning: All pairs in the family have the same missing-variable type.

explicit_premises: The ten law pairs are as listed in the paper's table (S235–S245).
The missing variable in each pair is agency.
assumptions_and_dependencies.theological_starting_premises: None inside the definition. The claim that the portrait matches one Person is a bridge claim outside the formalization.
assumptions_and_dependencies.non_vacuity_requirement: The list of ten law pairs must be non-empty and each pair must have a well-defined missing type.

verification_controls.command_or_evidence: Construct a LawPair with a different missing type and show SameGapType fails.
verification_controls.interpretation: Confirms the predicate is not vacuous.

result_and_boundary.what_is_established: If formalized, the definition and theorem would establish that the ten law pairs as listed share a common missing-variable type. This is a bookkeeping result about the paper's own table.
result_and_boundary.what_remains_open: Whether the physical laws actually have the properties the paper attributes to them; whether the spiritual readings are warranted; whether the shared gap is evidence of a single Person rather than a coincidence or an artifact of the paper's framing.
result_and_boundary.encoding_fidelity_review: The formalization is faithful to the paper's table but does not engage the physics. The 'missing variable' is treated as a type-level annotation, not as a substantive claim about the laws.
result_and_boundary.interpretive_connections: Connects to A04 (God in the completions) and to the paper's kill condition (S410: 'a force with no matching structure').

source_selection.exact_source_expression: Follow being all the way down and you arrive at the Cross. [P91-S315..S338]
source_selection.reason: The Descent is presented as a 24-step causal chain with the explicit claim 'No premise smuggled. No step skipped.' (S339–S340). This is a claim of logical validity of a chain of implications. It can be formalized as a sequence of implications in Lean, with each step as a hypothesis and the conclusion as the final step. The formalization would test whether the chain is valid as stated.

formal_object.exact_proposed_statement: Given a sequence of propositions P1, ..., P24 corresponding to the 24 steps of the Descent, and given implications P1 → P2, P2 → P3, ..., P23 → P24, the conclusion P24 (Christ is the convergence point) follows from P1 (God creates).

symbol_table.formal_definition: inductive DescentStep : Type | s01 | s02 | ... | s24
symbol_table.reader_meaning: The 24 steps of the causal chain.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def StepProp : DescentStep → Prop | s01 => GodCreates | s02 => CreationStands | ... | s24 => ChristConvergence
symbol_table.reader_meaning: The proposition asserted at each step.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def ChainValid : Prop := ∀ n, n < 24 → StepProp n → StepProp (n+1)
symbol_table.reader_meaning: Each step implies the next.

explicit_premises: The 24 steps are as listed in S315–S338.
Each implication StepProp n → StepProp (n+1) holds.
custom_axioms: The implications themselves are the substantive content; if assumed as axioms, the theorem is trivial. The formalization challenge is to derive them from more basic premises.
assumptions_and_dependencies.theological_starting_premises: The first step (God creates) is a theological premise. The chain is conditional on it.
assumptions_and_dependencies.non_vacuity_requirement: The chain must have at least one step and the propositions must be jointly satisfiable.

verification_controls.command_or_evidence: Remove one implication and show the conclusion no longer follows.

result_and_boundary.what_is_established: If formalized with the implications as hypotheses, the theorem establishes only that the chain is valid as a sequence of implications. It does not establish that any step is true.
result_and_boundary.what_remains_open: Whether each implication is actually true; whether the steps are correctly identified; whether the chain is complete (no smuggled premises).
result_and_boundary.encoding_fidelity_review: The formalization captures the logical structure but not the content of each step. The paper's claim 'No premise smuggled' (S339) is a claim about the derivation of each implication, which is not formalized here.
result_and_boundary.interpretive_connections: Connects to A05 (necessary ground) and to the paper's CDR grammar (S409).

source_selection.exact_source_expression: The empty tomb says the pattern outlives the substrate and decay gets reversed from outside. [P61-S219..S223]
source_selection.reason: The paper explicitly frames the empty tomb as two physics claims: (1) information survives the destruction of its container, and (2) entropy gets locally reversed by connecting the system to an external source. These are precise enough to be stated as formal propositions about information preservation and entropy reversal in open systems.

formal_object.exact_proposed_statement: In a physical system S with a substrate and a pattern, if the pattern is encoded in the substrate and the substrate is destroyed, then the pattern can survive only if it is also encoded in a source external to S. Furthermore, if S is a closed system with increasing entropy, then a local decrease in entropy in S requires an external source of order.

symbol_table.formal_definition: structure PhysicalSystem where Substrate : Type; Pattern : Type; encodes : Substrate → Pattern → Prop; Entropy : ℝ; Closed : Prop
symbol_table.reader_meaning: A physical system with a substrate, a pattern, an encoding relation, and an entropy value.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def SubstrateDestroyed (S : PhysicalSystem) : Prop := ∀ s : S.Substrate, False
symbol_table.reader_meaning: The substrate no longer exists.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def PatternSurvives (S : PhysicalSystem) (p : S.Pattern) : Prop := ∃ s : S.Substrate, S.encodes s p
symbol_table.reader_meaning: The pattern is still encoded somewhere.

symbol_table.formal_definition: def ExternalSource (S : PhysicalSystem) : Prop := ∃ T : PhysicalSystem, T ≠ S ∧ T.Entropy < S.Entropy
symbol_table.reader_meaning: A source outside S with lower entropy.

explicit_premises: The pattern is encoded in the substrate.
The system is closed and its entropy increases.
A local entropy decrease requires an external source.
custom_axioms: The claim that information cannot be destroyed (a physical principle, not a theorem of pure logic).
The Second Law of Thermodynamics for closed systems.
assumptions_and_dependencies.theological_starting_premises: The identification of the empty tomb with these physics claims is a bridge claim. The physics claims themselves are conditional.
assumptions_and_dependencies.non_vacuity_requirement: There must exist at least one physical system with a substrate and a pattern.

verification_controls.command_or_evidence: Construct a system where the pattern is only encoded in the substrate and show it does not survive destruction.
verification_controls.interpretation: Confirms the external-source hypothesis is needed.

result_and_boundary.what_is_established: If formalized, the theorem would establish conditional claims: pattern survival requires external encoding, and local entropy decrease requires an external source. These are restatements of known physics principles.
result_and_boundary.what_remains_open: Whether the empty tomb actually occurred; whether the pattern of a person is the kind of thing that can be externally encoded; whether the external source is God.
result_and_boundary.encoding_fidelity_review: The formalization captures the structural claims but not the empirical content. The paper's claim that the empty tomb 'proves' these things is stronger than what the formalization supports.
result_and_boundary.interpretive_connections: Connects to A05 (necessary ground) and to the paper's CDR grammar (S409).

lean4.notes: The Lean corpus was not searched in this run. All verification controls are NOT_RUN and all verification statuses are CANDIDATE or NOT_ATTEMPTED. The five candidates are ordered by strength of formalizability: A05 (necessary ground) is the strongest because the paper itself presents it as a mathematical argument with five requirements; A01 (ground axiom) is a meta-mathematical claim; A03 (ten laws) is a structural bookkeeping claim; A06 (Descent) is a logical-validity claim; A09 (empty tomb) is a physics-conditional claim. Claims A02, A04, A07, A08, A10–A17, A19–A21 were not selected for formalization because they are either narrative, methodological, empirical, or question-form claims that do not admit precise Lean statements without substantial additional interpretation. No existing Lean declarations were searched or matched.

stories.title_or_label: The Ground Before the Building (axiom-floor metaphor)
stories.setting_or_context: Formal systems and their foundational axioms
stories.plot_or_sequence: Every formal system has a floor it cannot dig beneath. Set theory pays nine axioms, Peano arithmetic five, general relativity two. This framework pays one: God. The axiom cannot be proven, and that inability is the signature of a genuine Layer 0.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: Low-to-moderate; uses architectural/building metaphor to make axiomatic grounding intuitive.

boundaries.what_it_shows: That axiomatic systems require unprovable foundations, and that the framework positions God as such a foundation.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That God actually is the correct or only possible ground axiom; that the analogy between mathematical axioms and metaphysical grounding is valid.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: Demonstration that a system can be fully grounded without an unprovable axiom, or that the Trinity is derivable from something deeper.

stories.notes: Structurally load-bearing: the axiom-floor metaphor is the paper's opening move and frames the entire argument.

stories.title_or_label: Physics as the Grammar of Love (created-medium narrative)
stories.setting_or_context: The created order as a medium for love, choice, and redemption
stories.plot_or_sequence: If God is sovereign, why physics? Because creatures who can receive and return love need a world that is not God, stable enough to be known, with real consequence, time, limits, and repair. Physics is the grammar of that world — not the Author, but the ordered language the Author speaks.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: Moderate; appeals to intuitions about love requiring real conditions.

boundaries.what_it_shows: A conceptual account of why a sovereign God might create a physical world.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That God actually did create for these reasons; that physics is in fact a 'medium' rather than a brute given.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: A demonstration that love and free choice are possible without any of the listed conditions (non-God world, consequence, time, limits, repair).

stories.notes: Provides the theological rationale for the physics-theology bridge; structurally load-bearing.

stories.title_or_label: The Portrait of Christ in Ten Forces
stories.setting_or_context: Properties of the four fundamental forces and other physical laws
stories.plot_or_sequence: Physics tells you WHAT each force does, not WHY. But when you collect the properties of all ten forces and read them together, they compose a portrait so specific that only one Person matches it. Gravity reads as grace; the strong force as love; electromagnetism as truth; thermodynamics as necessity; information as the Word.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: High; uses poetic parallel structure and scriptural quotations to create a sense of recognition.

boundaries.what_it_shows: That the measured properties of physical forces can be described in language that resonates with Christian character descriptions.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That this resonance is anything more than analogy or coincidence; that the forces were designed to have these properties; that the mapping is unique or non-arbitrary.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: A force whose properties cannot be mapped to any spiritual reading, or a demonstration that the mappings are arbitrary and could be reversed.

stories.notes: Central rhetorical set-piece; the Hessian matrix claim (S151-S156) is presented as independent confirmation but is not independently evidenced in this paper.

stories.setting_or_context: Hypothetical: if you woke up as God, what would you build, risk, permit, and redeem?
stories.plot_or_sequence: A nine-step sequence: God is self-sufficient goodness; love freely creates real others; real others require genuine agency; agency allows refusal; refusal closes the receiver against the source; a closed system decays; restoration must come from outside without destroying freedom; incarnation enters without coercing; cross and resurrection restore from within while preserving identity. Then four questions: Why must the witness be free? Why a tree? Why not make God impossible to miss? What about the cross? What does the empty tomb prove?
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: High; uses second-person immersion and narrative tension to make theological claims feel like necessary design decisions.

boundaries.what_it_shows: That a coherent narrative can be constructed in which the major Christian story beats follow from a small set of premises about love, agency, and consequence.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That this is the only or best possible narrative; that the premises are true; that the sequence is logically necessary rather than narratively plausible.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: A demonstration that the sequence contains a logical gap, or that an equally coherent alternative narrative exists from the same premises.

stories.notes: The thought experiment is presented as a narrative device; it is separable from the formal argument but carries much of the paper's persuasive weight.

stories.title_or_label: The Descent: 24 Steps to the Cross
stories.setting_or_context: A causal chain from God's creation to the Cross
stories.plot_or_sequence: God creates; creation stands; what stands is distinguishable; distinction makes being intelligible; what is intelligible carries information; what carries information can stand in relation; relation can be kept or broken; relation reveals value; value opens moral valence; moral valence makes right and wrong meaningful; right and wrong require agents who can choose; choice requires a world of rules, limits, time, and consequences; such a world permits decay, vulnerability, and loss; decay opens the possibility of adversarial refusal; the Enemy exploits disorder; adversarial action creates debt; perfect Justice requires payment; perfect Mercy wills restoration; Justice and Mercy together require a cost-bearing source beyond the damaged order; that source is Grace; Grace restores creation toward God; Christ is the convergence point.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: High; builds a sense of inexorable logic culminating in the Cross.

boundaries.what_it_shows: A step-by-step narrative chain connecting creation to redemption.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That each step is logically necessary; that no alternative chain is possible; that the chain is not question-begging at key junctures (e.g., the move from 'value' to 'moral valence' to 'agents who can choose').
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: Identification of a non sequitur in the chain, or a demonstration that the chain can be run in reverse or to a different conclusion.

stories.notes: Presented as a formal derivation ('No premise smuggled. No step skipped.'), but functions as a narrative arc. The claim of no smuggled premises is itself a claim requiring independent verification.

stories.setting_or_context: Biblical history from slavery in Egypt through exile
stories.plot_or_sequence: God does not dump the full signal on Day One because receivers cannot parse it. He meets them in slavery and turns deliverance into vocabulary for rescue. He meets them in wilderness and teaches provision. He meets them under Law so they can understand failing to keep it. He meets them through prophets building the pattern. He meets them in exile so they can understand return. This is not God being slow; this is God being a teacher.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: Moderate; uses pedagogical analogy to reframe apparent divine slowness as intentional pedagogy.

boundaries.what_it_shows: That the biblical narrative can be read as a progressive educational process.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That this is the correct or intended reading; that God actually operates this way; that alternative readings (e.g., gradual human moral development) are inferior.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: Evidence that biblical revelation does not follow a progressive pattern, or that the pedagogical analogy breaks down at key points.

stories.title_or_label: God in the Completions, Not the Gaps
stories.setting_or_context: The history of the 'God of the gaps' argument and its failures
stories.plot_or_sequence: Every generation, someone points at something science cannot explain and says 'therefore God.' Every generation, science explains it and God gets smaller. Darwin. Plate tectonics. Neuroscience. The gaps close. This paper does the opposite: it takes ten things science DID explain and shows that when read together, they describe a Person. Bonhoeffer saw this in 1944 and wrote from prison that we should not use God as a stopgap.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: Moderate-to-high; uses the historical failure of gap arguments to position this framework as superior.

boundaries.what_it_shows: That 'God of the gaps' arguments have historically failed and that this framework claims to avoid them.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That this framework actually avoids the gap problem; that reading ten laws together genuinely produces a portrait rather than a projection.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: Demonstration that the framework itself relies on gaps, or that the completions reading is as vulnerable to reinterpretation as gap arguments.

evidence_for_historical_content: Bonhoeffer's 1944 prison writings are cited but not directly quoted or referenced with a specific source.
stories.notes: The Bonhoeffer reference is a historical claim; the paper does not provide a specific citation, so it remains unverified within this document.

stories.setting_or_context: Philosophical argument from cosmological and coherence requirements
stories.plot_or_sequence: If closed systems collapse and the universe has not collapsed, something external sustains it. If coherence and decoherence are real, the source of coherence must be equally real. The required properties are: necessary, self-grounding, origin of coherence, active, personal. These properties have had a name for thousands of years: aseity, self-sufficiency, eternality, omnipresence, Logos, providence, personhood. We did not start from theology; we started from five mathematical proofs and arrived at the exact description theologians have been writing about.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: Moderate; presents itself as a neutral derivation from mathematics to theology.

boundaries.what_it_shows: That a set of required properties for a sustaining source can be mapped to classical divine attributes.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That the five mathematical proofs actually exist or are valid; that the mapping is unique; that the source must be personal rather than impersonal.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: Demonstration that the five proofs are invalid, or that the required properties can be satisfied by an impersonal source.

stories.notes: The five mathematical proofs are referenced but not presented in this paper; the argument is structurally load-bearing but its premises are not independently evidenced here.

stories.title_or_label: Every Door Leads to the Same Room
stories.setting_or_context: Convergence of multiple lines of inquiry
stories.plot_or_sequence: You can enter through logic, physics, information theory, biology, mathematics, cosmology, or the measurement of good and evil itself. Every path converges. Not because we forced it — but because reality has one substrate, and that substrate has been telling us its name since the beginning.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: High; uses the metaphor of converging paths to create a sense of inevitability and discovery.

boundaries.what_it_shows: That the paper claims multiple independent lines of inquiry converge on the same conclusion.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That these lines are actually independent; that the convergence is not an artifact of the framework's assumptions; that the 'same room' is not defined by the framework itself.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: Demonstration that the paths do not converge, or that they converge only because they share hidden assumptions.

stories.notes: Rhetorical flourish; separable from the formal argument but contributes to the paper's persuasive arc.

stories.setting_or_context: Methodological framework for testing claims across registers
stories.plot_or_sequence: If God is Truth, the framework must let its claims be tested. Every major claim is read in its proper register: theology, physics, mathematics, lived reality, bridge. Physics is not allowed to smuggle in theology. Theology is not allowed to rescue weak physics. Story is not allowed to pretend it is proof. But when the same structure appears across registers, we mark the bridge, name its strength, state its limits, and keep testing. No hidden upgrades.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: Moderate; positions the framework as intellectually honest and self-critical.

boundaries.what_it_shows: A stated methodology for cross-register testing.
boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That the methodology is actually followed in the paper; that the bridges are as weak as claimed; that the method prevents smuggling.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: Evidence that the paper violates its own method (e.g., smuggling theology into physics, or treating story as proof).

stories.notes: The method page is structurally important because it sets the rules for evaluating the paper's claims.

narrative_arc.opening_device: The axiom-floor metaphor: every formal system has a floor it cannot dig beneath, and this framework pays one axiom: God.
narrative_arc.central_tension: The tension between the claim that God is the necessary ground of all reality and the admission that this ground cannot be proven from within the system it sustains.
narrative_arc.resolution_or_payoff: The Cross: the uncorrupted pattern voluntarily enters the broken system, and 'It is finished' is successful deployment. The empty tomb demonstrates that information survives substrate destruction and entropy is locally reversed from outside.

stories.notes: The paper is heavily narrative in structure, using stories, thought experiments, and sermon arcs to carry its argument. The stories are not presented as evidence but as explanatory and persuasive devices. Several stories (e.g., the Descent, the Portrait of Christ) are structurally load-bearing and cannot be removed without damaging the paper's overall case. The paper explicitly acknowledges its own kill conditions (A13) and states that the match could be coincidence, which is a notable boundary condition. Historical claims (e.g., Bonhoeffer's 1944 writings) are referenced but not directly evidenced in this document.

master_equation_b.notes: The paper is primarily theological/philosophical with embedded quantitative empirical claims. No formal master equation expression is given; the reference at S393 is a title only. The 24-step Descent chain is qualitative and not dimensionally checkable. The ten-law mapping table (S235-S245) is structural correspondence, not mathematical equations. The paper explicitly states its mathematical status as 'partially formalized' (S402) and names kill conditions (S225-S230).

overall.summary: The paper is broadly coherent in its central theological-physical analogy, but it carries unresolved tensions around the status of the Trinity as an axiom, the nature of the ten-law mapping, and the relationship between physics and grace.

dimensions.name: internal_consistency
reasons: S040-S045 and S310-S312 consistently assert that God cannot be proven from within the system, aligning with the axiom status.
S056-S058 and S113-S121 consistently distinguish physics as created medium from God and grace.
S228-S229 and S410 consistently state that the argument does not rely on gaps but on completions.

However, S023-S039 claims the Trinity pays four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) from one structure, while S290-S297 presents a separate necessary-ground argument with five properties; the relationship between these two grounding arguments is not fully integrated.

S151-S156 cites a Hessian matrix scoring 'love' as most connected, but no formal model or data is provided, creating a tension between the claim of mathematical support and the absence of reproducible detail.

dimensions.name: definitional_stability
reasons: Key terms like 'axiom' (S010-S014, S040-S045) and 'Layer 0' (S044) are used consistently within the paper.
The ten laws are listed in S235-S245 with spiritual readings, but the criteria for mapping a physical law to a spiritual concept are not defined; the mapping appears analogical rather than formal.
The term 'agency' is identified as the repeated missing piece (S246-S249), but its precise definition and how it functions as a structural gap are not fully specified.
The 'Cross-Resolution Method' (S276-S288) defines registers and bridge rules, but the strength criteria for bridges are not quantified.
The 'necessary ground' argument (S290-S297) lists five properties, but the derivation of these properties from the premises is not fully shown.

dimensions.name: inferential_connectedness
reasons: The Descent (S315-S338) presents a 24-step causal chain with explicit logical connectors, though some steps (e.g., S322 'relation reveals value') are asserted rather than derived.

The argument from physics to the character of God (S124-S156) relies on reading properties together as a portrait; the inferential leap from properties to a specific Person is acknowledged as a bridge (S401) but not formally justified.

The necessary ground argument (S290-S297) moves from cosmological and coherence premises to divine attributes, but the step from 'active' to 'personal' (S297) is supported only by a parenthetical appeal to moral realism.

The claim that the empty tomb is a physics claim (S219-S223) connects information survival and entropy reversal to resurrection, but the physical principles are used analogically rather than as direct evidence.

dimensions.name: register_boundary_respect
reasons: The paper explicitly defines registers (theology, physics, mathematics, lived reality, bridge) in S277-S281 and states rules against smuggling (S282-S285).
It repeatedly marks bridges as declared and not proof (S401, S410).
It acknowledges the modest status of physics (S400) and the need for adversarial testing (S402).

However, some passages blur the boundary, e.g., S151-S156 presents a mathematical result (Hessian matrix) as supporting a theological claim without detailing the model, and S219-S223 calls the empty tomb a 'physics claim' while the physics is used analogically.
The claim that 'the math said it without being asked' (S156) risks implying that mathematics independently confirms theology, which would violate the stated bridge rules.

contradictions.description: A01 states the Trinity is the single ground axiom and cannot be proven. A05 presents a necessary ground argument that derives a personal, self-grounding source from cosmological and coherence premises. If the Trinity is the axiom, the necessary ground argument is either redundant or implies the Trinity can be partially proven from other premises, creating tension about the foundational status of the Trinity.

A03 claims the ten laws compose a portrait of Christ with agency as the repeated gap. A20 states the ten-law mappings need adversarial testing and are only partially formalized. This is a tension between the strong claim of a specific portrait and the acknowledged lack of formal validation.

tensions.description: A02 says physics is the created medium, not grace. A09 says the empty tomb is a physics claim about information survival and entropy reversal. The latter uses physics as direct evidence for a miraculous event, which may blur the boundary between medium and grace.

A04 claims God is in the completions, not the gaps. A13 acknowledges the match could be coincidence and a skeptic could write the opposite essay. This is an honest tension between the strength of the pattern and its potential coincidental nature.

A05 presents the necessary ground argument as having five proofs. A20 says mathematics is partially formalized and the necessary ground argument has five proofs, but the ten-law mappings need testing. The status of the five proofs is unclear: are they fully formalized or not?

Its coherence is strengthened by explicit method rules and self-imposed kill conditions, but weakened by unresolved integration of multiple grounding arguments and reliance on analogical mappings without formal criteria. The score reflects a generally coherent but not fully systematized framework.
